Menstrual Leave Policy

To provide one (1) paid menstrual leave day per calendar month (up to twelve (12) per year) to eligible
employees, supporting their health needs and promoting gender-sensitive workplace practices.

Hyderabad and Pune, the same entitlement is extended as a Company benefit without reducing any statutory
leaves.

Women employees are entitled to one (1) paid menstrual leave per calendar month, up to a maximum
of twelve (12) in a year.
These leaves may be availed monthly and taken as needed, based on the employee's individual health
requirements, by giving self-declaration.
Menstrual leave will not be considered as part of sick leave, paid leave, casual leave, or any other
regular leave category.
Employees availing menstrual leave are to report to their manager via standard leave application
procedures, preferably in advance or at their earliest convenience, to ensure workflow continuity.
The leave is paid as per the employee's regular wage, and no undue deduction will be made due to
such leave utilization.
This leave type cannot be combined with any other type of leave, except sick leave if required.
Leave may be taken as either a half-day or full day, but cannot be combined to exceed one day per
month.

Managers, HR, and payroll teams are responsible for ensuring alignment and compliance with this
policy.
Any concerns, requests, or grievances related to menstrual leave may be escalated to HR for prompt
resolution.
Leave applications should be approved upon self-declaration. Employees are not required to disclose
symptoms or medical details; records will only reflect the date the leave was availed.
Remote work or light duties may be considered only at the employee's preference, without imposing
such arrangements.

e Menstrual leave is not eligible for encashment and cannot be carried forward to subsequent months or
years.
e This leave is provided in addition to statutory leave types (sick, casual, earned) and shall not reduce
existing maternity or other statutory leave entitlements.
e If any state government mandates a higher entitlement in the future, the higher local entitlement will
apply for employees at that location; the company minimum entitlement remains one (1) day per
month for other locations.

e Non-compliance will have consequences as per the company policy.
e Employee misuse: Proven abuse or misuse of Menstrual leave policy by employee constitutes a
disciplinary matter; however, bona fide and legitimate use will not invite adverse action.

The Company reserves the right to revise, modify any or all clauses of this Policy, at its discretion and in
consonance with the change in any government policies or laws and notify the same to the employees.

The management will be the sole authority to interpret the content of this Policy. Any deviation to this Policy
needs to be approved by the management.
